title: filenode-server: blob-digest hook; fill sha256 when CID advertised
description: Add a FileNodeBackend blob-digest hook; FileNode/set create and update fill sha256 when jmap:cid is advertised (draft-atwood-jmap-cid-00 L222-224).
acceptance_criteria: Tests use an independent oracle: each assertion cites and quotes the governing draft sentence (file + line) or uses RFC/draft-published vectors; the code under test is never its own oracle. Test: create with a known blob yields the SHA-256 from a published vector (e.g. FIPS 180-4 'abc'); no CID capability -> no sha256.
